chunks: And Ismāʿīl ibn Rabāḥ narrated from Abī ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام that he said:
"If you performed salat (prayer) while believing that you were within the time, but the time had not yet entered, then the time entered while you were in the salat (prayer), it has sufficed for you."

key_terms.أَجْزَأَتْ عَنْكَ: it was sufficient and valid for you
key_terms.لَمْ يَدْخُلِ الْوَقْتُ: the prayer time had not yet entered

ai.seo_question: Is a prayer valid if I started before its time by mistake and the time entered during the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat (prayer) time: if a person begins praying thinking the prayer time has entered, and the time actually begins during the prayer, that prayer is sufficient. It addresses the validity of worship performed under a mistaken assumption about timing when the proper time enters before the prayer is completed.
